entities.name: Luke the Evangelist
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Physician and companion of Paul who authored the Gospel of Luke and Acts of the Apostles — together comprising 28% of the New Testament, the largest contribution by a single author. His meticulous historical approach and concern for the marginalized (women, poor, Gentiles) distinguishes his work.
